objective: Bound exit-source token retention for indefinite CW-11 observation without weakening incarnation or source identity guarantees.
required_change: Reuse exactly one internal fact ExitSourceToken per current run incarnation instead of issuing a token on every tick. Reset it on actual run-incarnation change; idempotent observations and authority-only changes must not grow storage.
Keep `_exit_sources` bounded by current live sources and remove/discard tokens when no longer usable. Confirm exit, run replacement, stale source, and failed/retried UI behavior must remain correct.

Audit `_external_exit_sources`: do not keep every historical WorkflowRun strongly reachable forever. Use a safe weak registration/pruning mechanism (or equally bounded explicit retirement) while preventing object-id reuse and old-source late binding. The current external source may remain strongly owned only while active/bound.
Add deterministic 1000+ tick no-review and multi-run/source churn tests asserting bounded registry sizes, plus token reuse, GC/retirement, old binding rejection, exit race and current probe behavior.
verification: Run full observation and related regressions.
Rerun actual OMP if token reuse affects probe path; otherwise explain evidence scope.
constraints: apply_patch only; no workflow records, uv/local env/package artifacts, destructive git actions, or graphify restore.
